title: Enemy AI State Does Not Reset to Idle
description: When the player moves beyond the enemy's detection radius, the enemy remains in PURSUING or ATTACKING state instead of returning to IDLE.
reproduction_steps: Move player within detection radius (state becomes PURSUING)
Observe that state is still PURSUING instead of IDLE
expected_behavior: Enemy should return to IDLE when player is beyond detection radius
actual_behavior: Enemy stays in PURSUING state indefinitely
